item.title: Detroit’s iconic Dittrich Furs closing after 132 years
item.description: By Meredith Bruckner CBS Evening News (Detroit) The doors are closing on what’s described as Detroit’s oldest family-owned business. The owners of Dittrich Furs announced the closure on Monday, and along with it, a liquidation sale offering more than $9 million worth of merchandise at a 70% discount. Ever since the announcement, customers waited in lines … Continue reading

item.title: Leaked Footage from Inside of Kaatz Bros. Lures in Savanna, Illinois
item.description: Kaatz Bros is a fox farm and urine farm. Urine is collected from captive foxes, bobcats and other animals to create trapping lures. A latch on a cage keeps these animals imprisoned and alienated from the natural world. For a complete list of fur farms visit finalnail.com

item.title: Meyn Poultry Equipment Gets Spraypainted, Locks Glued (Basingstoke, UK)
item.description: Received anonymously: This global company was targeted for their manufacture and supply of animal abusing/exploiting/killing machinery. This was my first action so unfortunately adrenaline got the better of me and I ended up making a spelling mistake, still I think they got the message, a lock was also glued up.
